script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “God speaks against Gog” is not shown to happen in Magog. Ezekiel is told to prophesy against Gog of Magog, but the passage does not locate Ezekiel there.

“Gog and Magog gather for battle” is not shown to happen in the land of Magog. Revelation uses Gog and Magog for nations from the four corners of the earth; the battle takes place around the camp of the saints and the beloved city.
“Set his face against” and “prophesy” may be difficult for fifth-grade readers. Simpler wording could explain that Ezekiel was to speak God’s message against Gog.
